review: 709.2-1: the second variant changed two facts (removed Forest and Island) under a does_not_fire label and its expected carried reasoning; reworded the delta as one fact (B's hand holds only Fire // Ice), set polarity other (a card-count identity has no does_not_fire branch) and stripped reasoning from both expecteds.

709.3a-1: decisions left the half unnamed; the short_on_mana variant (three Forests) is illegal under the combined cost too, so it did not exercise 709.3a; forge_notes named the wrong card. Fixed decisions to cast Battery, dropped short_on_mana, corrected forge_notes.
709.3b-1: cast_fire expected carried reasoning; restated as the legality verdict plus outcome.

709.3c-1: the single_card variant swapped in Shock and produced the same observable outcome as base (2 damage, Bears dies), so it flipped nothing; dropped it and Shock, set ice_half polarity to other (the rule cannot fail to apply) and cleaned the expecteds.

709.4-1: variants mislabelled (only_split_card was the real test yet marked fires alongside base; no_split_card was not a flip of base); forge_notes named Fire. Made the library hold only Turn // Burn in base (nothing found), with one does_not_fire variant swapping in Shock (found); added 709.4b, whose combined-mana-value clause this exercises.
709.4b-1: forge_notes named Fire; corrected to Turn and removed AI-behaviour wording from cast_turn's expected.
709.4c-1: forge_notes named Fire; corrected to Commit.
709.4d-1: forge_notes named Fire; corrected to Turn and removed AI-behaviour wording from burn_only's expected.

709.5a-1: the Central Elevator search ran over a Room card in the library, where 709.4 already gives the combined types, so it did not exercise the shared type line; replaced it with a playability scenario where Annul can target a cast Bottomless Pool half (an enchantment spell) but not the Ice half of Fire // Ice.
709.5d-1: decisions left the half unnamed; named Central Elevator in the decisions.
709.5d-2: cast_instead's delta named several changes loosely; restated it as the one fact varied (how the Room reaches the battlefield) with the mana it uses.
709.5f-1: in nothing_locked Locker Room is unlocked, so its combat-damage draw trigger fires and A would draw from an empty library; added Island to A's library and the draw to the expected.
709.5g-1: nothing_unlocked changed two facts (the Room's state and A's choice, switching to unlock); now changes only the starting state and A still chooses to lock, so no designation changes.
709.5h-1: other_door's delta reworded as the single varied fact (which door is locked) with its payment.

skipped.reason: cannot be illustrated reliably: the rule concerns the copiable values of a Room spell on the stack, whose only observable consequence (the designation a copied Room spell's token enters with) is fixed by rulings outside the rule text, and no record field exposes copiable values

scenarios.title: A split card is one card when discarded

setup.notes: Fire is the split card Fire // Ice.

decisions: A casts Mind Rot targeting B, tapping three Swamps.
Both players pass; Mind Rot resolves.
B chooses to discard Fire // Ice and Forest.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: B discards exactly two cards, Fire // Ice and Forest, which move to B's graveyard; Island stays in B's hand.

variants.label: lone_split_card
variants.delta: B's hand holds only Fire // Ice.
variants.expected: B discards Fire // Ice and B's hand is empty; one card moved to B's graveyard.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge names a split card by its first half's Name: line, so the card appears as 'Fire' in zones; its second half is the ALTERNATE Name: line. The rule has no does_not_fire branch: a split card is always one card.

scenarios.title: Only the chosen half of a split card is checked for castability

setup.notes: Assault is the split card Assault // Battery, combined mana cost {3}{R}{G}; Assault costs {R}, Battery costs {3}{G}.

decisions: A casts the Battery half ({3}{G}) of Assault // Battery, tapping the four Forests.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Casting Battery is legal; it resolves and A creates a 3/3 green Elephant token.

variants.label: other_half
variants.delta: A chooses the Assault half ({R}) targeting Grizzly Bears instead, still with only the four Forests.
variants.expected: Casting Assault is illegal: {R} cannot be paid with Forests.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge names a split card by its first half's Name: line, so the card appears as 'Assault' in zones; its second half is the ALTERNATE Name: line.

scenarios.title: A split spell on the stack has only the characteristics of the half cast

setup.notes: Fire is the split card Fire // Ice: Fire is red, Ice is blue, the card in hand is both.

decisions: A casts the Ice half ({1}{U}) targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping Island and Mountain.
A passes priority.
B casts Red Elemental Blast choosing the mode 'counter target blue spell', targeting Ice and tapping Mountain.
Both players pass; Red Elemental Blast resolves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Ice is a blue spell, so Red Elemental Blast has a legal target and counters it: Ice goes to A's graveyard, Grizzly Bears is not tapped, A draws no card.

variants.label: cast_fire
variants.delta: A casts the Fire half ({1}{R}) instead, dealing 2 damage to Grizzly Bears; B has Red Elemental Blast available.
variants.expected: Fire is a red spell only: Red Elemental Blast cannot be cast (no blue spell or blue permanent to target); Fire resolves and Grizzly Bears dies.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge names a split card by its first half's Name: line, so the card appears as 'Fire' in zones; its second half is the ALTERNATE Name: line.

scenarios.title: A cast copy of a split card keeps both halves

setup.notes: Fire is the split card Fire // Ice in A's graveyard.

decisions: A casts Mizzix's Mastery ({3}{R}) targeting Fire // Ice in A's graveyard, tapping four Mountains.
Both players pass; Mizzix's Mastery resolves, exiling Fire // Ice and copying it.
A casts the copy without paying its mana cost, choosing the Fire half, dealing 2 damage to Grizzly Bears.
Both players pass; the copy resolves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: The copy is cast as Fire: Grizzly Bears is dealt 2 damage and dies. The copy ceases to exist and Mizzix's Mastery is exiled.

variants.label: ice_half
variants.delta: A casts the copy as the Ice half, targeting Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: The copy is cast as Ice: Grizzly Bears becomes tapped and A draws Island. Mizzix's Mastery is exiled.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge names a split card by its first half's Name: line, so the card appears as 'Fire' in zones; its second half is the ALTERNATE Name: line. Forge's Play effect with CopyCard$ True may not offer the half choice for a copied split card. The rule has no does_not_fire branch: a cast copy of a split card always keeps both halves.

setup.notes: Turn is the split card Turn // Burn: Turn {2}{U} (MV 3), Burn {1}{R} (MV 2), combined mana cost {2}{U}{1}{R} (MV 5). Spellseeker searches for an instant or sorcery card with mana value 2 or less.

decisions: A casts Spellseeker, tapping three Islands.
Both players pass; Spellseeker resolves and enters.

variants.label: base

variants.label: single_card
variants.delta: A's library holds Shock instead of Turn // Burn.
variants.expected: A finds Shock and puts it into hand.

scenarios.title: A split card in the graveyard has the card types of both halves

setup.notes: Commit is the split card Commit // Memory: Commit is an instant, Memory a sorcery. Dragon's Rage Channeler checks for four or more card types among cards in its controller's graveyard.

variants.label: base

variants.label: instant_only
variants.delta: A's graveyard holds Shock instead of Commit // Memory.
variants.expected: The graveyard holds instant, creature and land types: three card types, so Dragon's Rage Channeler is a 1/1 without flying.

scenarios.title: A split card has the chosen name if either of its names is chosen

setup.notes: Fire is the split card Fire // Ice in B's hand.

decisions: A casts Memoricide targeting B, tapping four Swamps.
On resolution A chooses the card name Ice.
A exiles all cards named Ice from B's graveyard, hand and library.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Fire // Ice has the name Ice, so it is exiled from B's hand; Grizzly Bears stays in B's hand.

variants.label: first_name
variants.delta: A chooses the name Fire.
variants.expected: Fire // Ice has the name Fire, so it is exiled from B's hand; Grizzly Bears stays in B's hand.

variants.label: other_name
variants.delta: A chooses the name Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Only Grizzly Bears is exiled; Fire // Ice stays in B's hand.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge names a split card by its first half's Name: line, so the card appears as 'Fire' in zones; its second half is the ALTERNATE Name: line. Forge's NamedCard matching for a card with two halves may only compare the combined or first name.

scenarios.title: A fused split spell has the characteristics of both halves

setup.notes: Turn is the split card Turn // Burn with fuse. Turn is blue, Burn is red.

decisions: A casts Turn // Burn fused ({2}{U} plus {1}{R}), tapping all five lands; Turn targets Grizzly Bears and Burn targets B.

scenarios.title: A locked half gives the permanent none of its name, cost or rules text

setup.notes: Bottomless Pool is the Room Bottomless Pool // Locker Room with only the right half (Locker Room) unlocked. Locker Room: whenever one or more creatures you control deal combat damage to a player, draw a card.

decisions: A attacks B with Grizzly Bears.
B declares no blockers.
Combat damage is dealt.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Locker Room is unlocked, so its triggered ability exists: it fires and A draws a card. B is at 18 life.

variants.label: pool_only
variants.delta: Only the left half (Bottomless Pool) is unlocked, not Locker Room.
variants.expected: The Room has the name Bottomless Pool and no Locker Room rules text: no trigger fires, A draws no card. B is at 18 life.

scenarios.title: A half of a Room cast as a spell has the shared Enchantment type

setup.notes: Bottomless Pool is the Room Bottomless Pool // Locker Room, shared type line Enchantment - Room. Fire is the split card Fire // Ice, two instants with no shared type line.

decisions: A casts the Bottomless Pool half ({U}), tapping one Island.
A passes priority.
B casts Annul targeting the Room spell, tapping Island.
Both players pass; Annul resolves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: The Bottomless Pool spell is an enchantment spell: Annul is castable with it as target and counters it; the Room card goes to A's graveyard.

variants.label: no_shared_type_line
variants.delta: A's hand holds Fire // Ice instead of the Room, and A casts the Ice half ({1}{U}) targeting B's Island, tapping both Islands.
variants.expected: Ice is an instant spell only: Annul cannot be cast. Ice resolves, B's Island becomes tapped and A draws Island.

scenarios.forge_notes: Rooms are split cards in Forge (AlternateMode:Split) whose halves each carry Types:Enchantment Room.

variants.label: right_half

scenarios.title: A Room that was not cast enters with neither half unlocked

setup.notes: Central Elevator is the Room Central Elevator // Promising Stairs in A's graveyard.

decisions: A casts Replenish ({3}{W}), tapping Plains and three Islands.
Both players pass; Replenish resolves, returning the Room to the battlefield.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: The Room enters without being cast and has neither unlocked designation: no unlock trigger fires, A's library is unchanged and the permanent has no name or rules text of either half.

variants.label: cast_instead
variants.delta: The Room starts in A's hand instead of A's graveyard, and A casts its Central Elevator half ({3}{U}) with the same four lands instead of casting Replenish.
variants.expected: The Room enters with the left half unlocked and the unlock trigger fires: A takes Bottomless Pool // Locker Room from the library.

scenarios.title: Unlocking a door by paying its cost is a special action for a main phase with an empty stack

setup.notes: Bottomless Pool is the Room Bottomless Pool // Locker Room with only the right half (Locker Room) unlocked; the unlock cost of the left half is {U}. Shock is inert unless a variant says otherwise.

decisions: A tries to pay {U} to unlock the left half of the Room, tapping Island.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: A has priority in their own main phase with an empty stack: the special action is legal.

variants.label: stack_not_empty
variants.delta: A has first cast Shock targeting B, tapping Mountain, and Shock is still on the stack.
variants.expected: The special action is illegal while the stack is not empty.

variants.label: opponent_turn
variants.delta: B is the active player and it is B's main phase with an empty stack.
variants.expected: The special action is illegal: it is not A's turn.

variants.label: combat
variants.delta: The step is beginning_of_combat on A's turn with an empty stack.
variants.expected: The special action is illegal: it is not a main phase.

setup.notes: Bottomless Pool is the Room Bottomless Pool // Locker Room, starting with only the right half (Locker Room) unlocked. Bottomless Pool's door: when you unlock this door, return up to one target creature to its owner's hand; unlock cost {U}. Locker Room's unlock cost is {4}{U}.

decisions: A pays {U} as a special action, tapping an Island, to unlock the left half (Bottomless Pool).
